note: Viral death cam, client only: nothing is uploaded or stored, the clip stays on the device. A rolling in-memory ring of small frames (copied from the game canvas a few times a second, not a video encoder running all the time) keeps the last buffer.seconds; when a shareable moment fires its frames are frozen and, only when the player taps the SHARE card, replayed through canvas.captureStream + MediaRecorder (the Frankendom 1 recipe: MP4 where the browser records it, WebM elsewhere) into one file. A browser that cannot record falls back to a branded PNG still. The link is the game homepage and nothing else (no player data). COPY RATE: tiers.<name>.fps is how many times a second the canvas is copied into the ring (one drawImage of about 0.6-0.8 ms in software GL, unmeasured on a phone); fps 0 (low) turns the ring off (a still is still offered), and no copy is made in offAreas (the hub). ?noshare=1 turns the whole feature off. Sizes and rates are PROVISIONAL until measured on a phone at 375 wide.
